entities.summary: The national museum of san matteo in pisa (museo nazionale di san matteo) displays works from historic ecclesiastical buildings in the city and province of pisa Originating c. 1949 CE. National Museum of San Matteo is a art museum with roots in Europe, arising around 1949-11-13.
